title: Irish Porridge Breakfast
description: A hearty, comforting breakfast porridge made with Irish oats and a hint of sweetness. Serve warm with a sprinkle of jewelled sugar on top.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil.
Add the Irish oats and reduce heat to low.
Simmer for 5-7 minutes or until the oats have absorbed most of the water and have a creamy consistency.
Stir in the jewelled sugar, if using.
Serve warm and top with post-workout protein powder, if desired.
Add a splash of milk or cream, if desired.
